learning.objective: Begin the transition from decision to useful external action while preserving evidence of why the action was selected.
observations: Action should follow verified opportunity evidence.
The selected post must be re-read before action.
A useful response must be relevant to the actual context.
Action results must be stored for future learning.
No action should occur when evidence is insufficient.
Autonomy should increase only when decision quality is demonstrated.
learning.next_learning_target: Measure whether controlled actions produce useful responses, engagement or real work opportunities.
